answer: What keeps this honest is ZCAP-LD linked-data capability, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. Faking 404 identities means 404 fresh proofs and 45652 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One signal of signal, one glacier of cost, one shale of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
